title: UK Local Authorities by Sewage Gas Generation
desc: Local authorities in the United Kingdom with reported sewage gas in 2025, ranked by value. The publisher suppresses some values to protect site confidentiality.

source.name: Department for Energy Security and Net Zero, Renewable electricity by local authority, 2014 to 2025
source.note: AllRanks assistant verified on 2026-10-22 against the Department for Energy Security and Net Zero original workbook “Renewable electricity by local authority, 2014 to 2025”, worksheets “LA - Generation, 2025” and “LA - Capacity, 2025”. Checked all included local authority names, metric columns, values, units and descending order. Rows for regional/national aggregates were excluded. Values marked [X] by the publisher are suppressed and omitted; only positive, numeric local-authority observations are listed, so rankings may omit areas with suppressed values. This is a source-data check, not independent measurement.
